items.question_text:
AI(artificial intelligence 人工智能)技术已经融入了我们生活的方方面面。假设你是九年级的李华, 学校正在举办科技节, 你应邀参加以“AI has changed our lives”为主题的演讲比赛。请你结合自身或他人经历, 用英语写一篇不少于 60 词的短文, 介绍 AI 给生活带来的至少两方面的变化及你对 AI 技术的观点。
(注意: 1.文中不得出现姓名、校名等个人信息, 否则不予评分。2.照抄阅读语篇不得分。)
items.student_answer: Hello, everyone. Nowadays, the AI technology has changed our lives a lot. For example, we can search for the information conveniently by asking AI. In addition, AI can communicate with us so that we won't feel very bored. Therefore, AI helps us a lot. In my opinion, the AI technology is not only wonderful but also dangerous. Some people will use AI to do something harmful to people on the Internet. We should be careful when we are surffing on the Internet. Thank you very much.

strengths: Well-structured with a clear introduction, body, and conclusion.
Directly addresses all parts of the prompt.
Good use of logical linking words.
weaknesses: Unnecessary use of the definite article 'the' before abstract or general nouns.
suggestions: Review spelling rules for adding '-ing' to verbs (surf -> surfing).
Practice the usage of articles with uncountable and general nouns.

a_round.encouragement: 你的作文结构非常清晰，能够熟练运用连接词和 'not only... but also...' 这样的高级句式，这在考场上是很加分的！虽然有一些拼写和冠词上的小瑕疵，但瑕不掩瑜。建议在复习时多关注不可数名词（如information）的用法，相信你的写作水平会再上一个台阶！加油！
a_round.corrected_version: Hello, everyone. Nowadays, AI technology has changed our lives a lot. For example, we can search for information conveniently by asking AI. In addition, AI can communicate with us so that we won't feel bored. Therefore, AI helps us a lot in our daily lives. In my opinion, AI technology is not only wonderful but also potentially dangerous. Some people might use AI to do something harmful to others on the Internet. We should be careful when we are surfing on the Internet. Thank you very much.
